title: Prefix Autocomplete Trie

visible.label: Insert, exact search, starts_with, and sorted autocomplete
visible.inputDisplay: Insert metrics, merge, memo, mode; query prefix "me"
visible.script:
t = Trie()
for w in ["metrics", "merge", "memo", "mode"]:
    t.insert(w)
assert t.search("memo") is True
assert t.search("mem") is False
assert t.starts_with("mem") is True
assert t.autocomplete("me") == ["memo", "merge", "metrics"]

visible.label: Unknown prefix yields empty autocomplete list

hidden.label: Empty prefix returns all inserted words sorted
Empty word handled cleanly if inserted
hidden.script:
t = Trie()
assert t.search("") is False
t.insert("")
assert t.search("") is True
assert t.autocomplete("") == [""]

hidden.label: Prefix which is itself a stored word appears first in autocomplete
hidden.script:
t = Trie()
t.insert("apple")
t.insert("app")
assert t.search("app") is True
assert t.autocomplete("app") == ["app", "apple"]

hidden.label: Duplicate insert remains deduplicated cleanly
hidden.script:
t = Trie()
t.insert("tag")
t.insert("tag")
assert t.autocomplete("t") == ["tag"]

hidden.label: Large vocabulary lookup without scanning unrelated prefixes
hidden.inputDisplay: Insert 1500 words and query selective prefix
hidden.script:
t = Trie()
for i in range(1500):
    t.insert(f"item_{i:04d}")
t.insert("target_alpha")
t.insert("target_beta")
assert t.autocomplete("target_") == ["target_alpha", "target_beta"]
